correctness.rationale: On the equality preorder, subset refinement reverses inclusion and every subset is a localized upset. Thus a CM modal cover at one world induces exactly an upset of the Boolean lattice, giving an arbitrary monotone Boolean coordinate. SL modal inclusion restricts each cover to \(\varnothing\) or \(\{w\}\), yielding exactly false/identity/true behavior. PLL identity removes the false behavior, while transitivity is automatic for the remaining two local cover families. CK-box seriality plus pairwise confluence makes each finite cover family downward directed, so repeated confluence produces its total intersection as an actual least cover; hence the induced operator is exactly a relational Kripke box. The verifier exhaustively checks these reductions for the stated small bases and independently reproduces the Dedekind/local-behavior counts.

originality.rationale: Every load-bearing structural statement is an elementary specialization of Valliappan's published semantic and algebraic theorems. The paper proves that CM modal covers induce arbitrary monotone operators on the localized-upset Heyting algebra; on the discrete base that algebra is exactly the powerset Boolean algebra. It defines SL by modal inclusion, PLL by adding identity and transitivity, and CK-box by seriality and confluence, and proves that the CK-box operator preserves finite meets. On a finite powerset algebra these conditions mechanically yield the three-point SL behavior, fixed-subset PLL nucleus, and principal-filter/Kripke representation. The numerical counts then use standard Boolean-lattice counting. Under the audit rule that corollaries and special cases are covered even without matching wording or numbers, the result is implication-level covered.

limitations: The base refinement is equality and the only local cover is the singleton \(\{w\}\).
